text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City becomes aware of her reputation through her friend Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fans seem excited by her prospects, particularly the possibility of her aiming for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She receives support even from her manager, who was initially reluctant about her becoming a runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The unexpected positive reaction from everyone provides a boost to her morale.
